data.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD4: A no-input feature replay (refactor/hook-fix/infra-only brainstorm) confirms the Inputs bullet states "no external inputs" verified by Read/Grep against the produced epic ticket description.

## What to Do
Create `tests/brainstorm/test-no-input-replay.sh` (chmod +x) with function `test_no_input_feature_replay`.

The test documents: given a brainstorm prompt for a refactor/infra-only change (e.g., "refactor the login handler to reduce duplication"), when the Inputs dimension is probed, then the Understanding Summary's Inputs bullet should state "no external inputs" (or equivalent). Verified by reading the produced epic ticket description via .claude/scripts/dso ticket show.

Fails RED because run_brainstorm_replay helper doesn't exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] File created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/brainstorm/test-no-input-replay.sh
- [ ] test_no_input_feature_replay function present
  Verify: grep -q "test_no_input_feature_replay" tests/brainstorm/test-no-input-replay.sh
- [ ] Test FAILS RED
  Verify: bash tests/brainstorm/test-no-input-replay.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] RED marker in .test-index
  Verify: grep "test_no_input_feature_replay" .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create RED replay stub: no-input feature confirms 'no external inputs' in produced ticket (1023-1ceb DD4)
